dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: The floorboards need sweeping, the rugs need washing, maybe even replacing, and as for all those books on the shelves... Looks like they could do with someone going through and organizing them a little better.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: You should go rest, leave all that to me!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Hmm? Pushing myself too hard? No I'm not! This is my way of relaxing.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: #Thank you for inviting me to join your domain exploration team, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I have to learn to defeat powerful enemies if I want to become a knight.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: When it's time to go into battle, I will give it everything I have!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I've finished cleaning the place, and nobody needs my help right now...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: The dishes are washed, and the coffee and snacks I prepared as a thank-you gift are ready to serve...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: #If it's not too much of an imposition, would you mind giving me some guidance on my sword work, {NICKNAME}?
